items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: When I was over...over at Dreamland there, he left with...Iain Buster Bailey.

ctx.x: It was about 1926, I believe, when the records were made. Were made, yeah. Yeah. They say Armstrong was in New York with Henderson. Yeah, he left there for...yeah.
When I was over...over at Dreamland there, he left with...Iain Buster Bailey. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Well that must have been... Do you remember anything about those dates? I think that was Ori and St. Cyr and Dodds, some of the best records they made, and you sound wonderful on those too. Yeah.
